description: Sequential voltage source of three, four or five steps, each with its own level and its own gate, run from an internal pulser or an external clock

params.text: Sets this step's level; the tooltip reads out the voltage it will put out in the range chosen on the menu
Switches this step's gate on and off; a step with its gate off plays its own level at the CV output all the same
Sets the sequence length; the switch reads 3, 5 and 4 from left to right, following the lever on the original hardware
Sets the rate of the internal pulser, which runs the sequence whenever nothing is patched to the clock input

inputs.text: An external clock; while a cable is patched here it replaces the internal pulser, and a step is taken on each rising edge

outputs.text: The level of the step the sequence has reached, in the range chosen on the menu
10V while the clock is high and the current step's gate button is lit, 0V otherwise, whatever shape the incoming clock has
The clock driving the sequence: the internal pulser, or a copy of the voltage at the clock input while one is patched

notes: with nothing patched to the clock input the internal pulser runs the sequence on its own, as a clean square wave at half duty.
the lamp beside a step is lit while that step is playing, and steps past the chosen length never light.
menu: CV Range: 0V to +5V, 0V to +10V, -5V to +5V, -10V to +10V — sets the range the step levels are spread across, and the voltage the step knobs read out

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the internal pulser.
